title: HB 215 (2018 Regular Session): AN ACT relating to voter identification.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1, KRS 117.227(1)
(quote) (1) Election officers shall confirm the identity of each voter by personal acquaintance or by one (1) of the following documents:[ a document, such as ] (a) A motor vehicle operator's license;[, ] (b) An instruction permit for a motor vehicle or motorcycle; (c) An intermediate license to operate a motor vehicle;
(section) Sec. 1, KRS 117.227(1)(d)-(i)
(quote) (d) A Social Security card;[, ] (e) Any identification card that has been issued by a city or[ the] county government that includes a picture of the voter and which has been approved in writing by the State Board of Elections;[, any identification card with picture and signature, ] (f) Any United States government-issued identification card;[, ] (g) Any Kentucky state government-issued identification card that includes a picture of the voter;[ with picture, or credit card. ] (h) Any public or private college or university-issued identification card that includes a picture of the voter; or (i) Any public or private high school-issued identification card that includes a picture of the voter.
(section) Sec. 1, KRS 117.227(2)
(quote) (2) The election officer confirming the identity shall sign the precinct voter roster and list the method of identification.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Only one section (KRS 117.227); nothing else in the bill.
(other) version: bill (only saved version, as introduced): ID text in slot a only. Reads like the 2017 HB258 list recast as subsections (a)-(i) with the same items; no new items found against that bill.
(other) note: Status 1; last action 2018-02-22 "posted in committee"; no roll call. Underline marks lost; bracketed words ("[ a document, such as ]", "[, ]", "[ the]", "[, any identification card with picture and signature, ]", "[ with picture, or credit card. ]") are deleted, as in HB258. The bill description says it requires "a picture identification card issued by a governmental or educational entity", but the text does not: a licence, instruction permit, intermediate licence and Social Security card carry no picture requirement, and personal acquaintance remains an alternative. Photo is required only for the city/county, Kentucky state, college/university and high-school cards. No consequence for lacking ID is stated (slot b not stated).
